Backend Engineer

Globex Austin, TX

Globex is hiring a Backend Engineer for its payments group. You will design the APIs that move money between merchants and banks, and you will be on call for them.

Responsibilities: build services in Java and Kotlin, write the runbooks, and improve our test coverage.

Requirements: four years of backend experience, strong SQL, and experience with event-driven systems such as Kafka. Benefits include equity and a remote-first culture.
